chunks: That the length of the ark of Nuh, peace be upon him, was one thousand and two hundred cubits, its width was one hundred cubits, and its height into the sky was eighty cubits. Then he boarded it, and it circled the House seven circuits, and traversed between al-Safa and al-Marwah seven times, then

key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Safa, one of the two well-known hajj sites
key_terms.الْبَيْتِ: the Sacred House, i.e. the Ka'bah
key_terms.الْجُودِيِّ: al-Judi, the mountain upon which the ark came to rest
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: al-Marwah, the other of the two well-known hajj sites
key_terms.نُوحٍ: Nuh, the prophet Noah عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What does this narration say about the ark of Nuh عليه السلام and its connection to the Ka'bah and al-Judi?
ai.summary: This report describes the dimensions of the ark of Nuh عليه السلام and relates that it circled the Ka'bah and went between al-Safa and al-Marwah before coming to rest on al-Judi. It connects the story of Nuh عليه السلام with sacred symbols associated with hajj and echoes the Qur'anic statement about the ark's resting place.
